results.title: PUTIN-XI POWER PLAY: West On Huge Alert, US Hegemony OVER As Russia-China Trade Boom To Set Record
results.description: Putin says Russia-China trade is on track for another record, building on nearly $240 billion in trade between the two powers in 2025. As Moscow and Beijing deepen economic ties, energy cooperation, mutual investment and bilateral trade remain key pillars of their growing partnership. Putin has indicated that trade could set a fresh record by the end of 2026, highlighting the strength of economic ties between Russia and China despite Western pressure and sanctions. The latest figures underline the expanding Moscow-Beijing partnership and its growing importance in global trade and geopolitics. #Putin #XiJinping #RussiaChina #Russia #China #Trade #Geopolitics #MoscowBeijing #EconomicPower #GlobalTrade

results.title: 'Padmaavat' writer Prakash Kapadia backs Jauhar scene; says ‘reality of those times’ cannot be changed; reacts to Swara Bhasker's criticism
results.description: Padmaavat co-writer Prakash Kapadia defended the film's Jauhar sequence. He stated the depiction reflected historical realities and research from that period. Kapadia mentioned that viewers interpret films based on their own perspectives and intentions. He also noted that the practice of Kesariya involved male warriors preparing for certain death. The film faced significant controversy and protests before its eventual release.

results.title: India News | Manoj Jarange Patil Ends Hunger Strike, Says Would Remain Firm on Quota Demands
results.description: Get latest articles and stories on India at LatestLY. Maratha reservation activist Manoj Jarange Patil on Wednesday ended his hunger strike by drinking water offered by BJP MLA Prasad Lad, even as he maintained that he would remain firm on his demands and would call off the agitation only after their implementation begins.
